column1: # Fonts for which the original figlet 2.2.5 cannot produce a usable render for any combination of
# layout, direction and justification, excluded entirely from the CLI comparison.
# Source: full diagnostic sweeps of 2026-10-16, see plans/figlet-cli-comparison-harness-fix.md
#   utf8-subcharacters   the font uses multi-byte UTF-8 sub-characters and the original figlet emits
#                        control bytes for them in every combination
#   blank-or-garbage     the original figlet renders the font as blank output, or as control-byte
#   smushing-divergence  the font uses a sub-character with code greater than 127, which the original
#                        figlet treats as smushable background during smushing; Figlet4s doesn't
#                        implement this rule yet and renders it wider
#   rendering-divergence Figlet4s renders the font differently from the original figlet (deterministic
#                        clean-output mismatch observed across layouts and directions); excluded until
